description: This file defines the PHP class `CodeCatalystClient` for interacting with the Amazon CodeCatalyst service; it includes method annotations for various API operations.

classes.name: CodeCatalystClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon CodeCatalyst API, extending the generic AWS SDK client.

methods.name: createAccessToken
methods.description: Creates a new access token for CodeCatalyst.

methods.name: createAccessTokenAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new access token for CodeCatalyst.

methods.name: createSourceRepositoryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new source repository.

methods.name: createSourceRepositoryBranch
methods.description: Creates a branch in a source repository.

methods.name: createSourceRepositoryBranchAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a branch in a source repository.

methods.name: getDevEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves details of a dev environment.

methods.name: getDevEnvironmentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a dev environment.

methods.name: getProjectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a project.

methods.name: getSourceRepository
methods.description: Retrieves details of a source repository.

methods.name: getSourceRepositoryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a source repository.

methods.name: getSourceRepositoryCloneUrls
methods.description: Retrieves clone URLs for a source repository.

methods.name: getSourceRepositoryCloneUrlsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves clone URLs for a source repository.

methods.name: getSpaceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a space.

methods.name: getWorkflowAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a workflow.

methods.name: getWorkflowRun
methods.description: Retrieves details of a workflow run.

methods.name: getWorkflowRunAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a workflow run.

methods.name: listSourceRepositoryBranches
methods.description: Lists branches in a source repository.
